subject: Film & Cinema
title: Disney vs. Everyone: The Competition
description: A micro-lesson that makes Disney vs. Everyone: The Competition usable.

hook.text: For decades, competing with Disney in animation meant losing. Then studios found their own voices.

buildup.text: Don Bluth, DreamWorks, and Blue Sky all challenged Disney's dominance with varying success.

discovery.text: Shrek's irreverent humor directly mocked Disney conventions — and audiences loved it.

twist.text: Disney eventually acquired Pixar, solving its 3D problem by buying the competition.

climax.text: Competition pushed Disney to evolve — without rivals, the empire would have stagnated.

punchline.text: The king needed challengers to stay sharp.

quiz.question: How did Shrek challenge Disney?
options: By mocking Disney conventions with irreverent humor
